read_this_first: If you have just found HAWKING_ODYSSEY_READY_AUDIT.json with its six green gates and 87/87 dry-run checks, that receipt is TRUE and it is NOT permission to train. It measured integrity and infrastructure. It never measured whether the artifact can generate. This file records what was measured afterwards, and the answer refuses the launch.

supersedes.the_gap: no probe of generation existed at the time it was sealed. HAWKING_MODEL_FEEL_PARITY_RESULTS.json recorded GLM-5.2 Math-Preserve as NOT_MEASURED, and nothing in the six gates required it.

what_remains_true_from_the_superseded_re: complete BPW 0.9774017488417455, exact rational 127830903/130786448, one-bit law legal
244,667,548 bytes headroom under the H0.98 target
allocation manifest byte-identical between repository and artifact
the runner refuses T0 while the fence is false
what_that_evidence_never_showed: that the artifact can generate. Integrity and capability are different claims, and every item above is an integrity claim.

math_probe.why_decisive: a mathematics continuation failing on an artifact whose whole purpose is preserving mathematics. It cannot be set aside as a general-knowledge probe outside the profile.

serve_output.prompt_b: Write a Python function that reverses a string.
serve_output.explained_by: the templated prompt's own top-5 is [24]'9'=10.432, [21]'6'=9.408, [23]'8'=9.053; token id 24 IS '9'. The HTTP path returned exactly what the model gave it.

failure_attribution.runtime: EXONERATED -- oracle and Rust/Metal agree on argmax and top-5 in exact order, on both probes, on Math-Preserve itself rather than inherited from the R0 parity receipt
failure_attribution.tokenizer: EXONERATED -- 'The capital of France is' encodes to [785, 6722, 315, 9621, 374] decoding to ['The',' capital',' of',' France',' is']
failure_attribution.chat_template: EXONERATED -- a control-token bisect shows bare text with no control tokens fails too
failure_attribution.serve_path: EXONERATED -- reproduces the model's own argmax exactly
failure_attribution.shape: not a dead vector: logits finite across all 154,880 entries, spread 16.9-21.2, peaked, and different per prompt. The model reads its input. What is gone is semantics.

representation_escalation_requirement.rule: representation-before-BPW: a stronger representation family must be tried at sub-bit before any BPW escalation, and escape above one complete BPW additionally requires a sealed Escape Receipt
evidence_the_law_explicitly_refuses: f1_only -- 'F1 weight reconstruction is NOT capability proof; escape denied'
scheduler_deferred -- 'scheduler deferral is not scientific collapse; escape denied'
representation_escalation_requirement.why_this_finding_qualifies_where_those_d: it is a live generation failure on the real flagship artifact at a known exact-rational BPW, confirmed by a numpy oracle reading the same container through the same codec, on two probes including one inside the artifact's own profile.
ordered_next_steps: representation escalation at sub-bit, preregistered in HAWKING_REPRESENTATION_ESCALATION_TOURNAMENT.json
only if every materially different sub-bit family fails, consider a separately versioned parity artifact above one BPW under a sealed Escape Receipt
re-probe any successor against its own hash before anything trains on it
representation_escalation_requirement.do_not_weaken: the strict sub-bit Frontier contract. A parity artifact above 1 BPW is a separately versioned thing, not a relaxation of the frontier.

enforcement.not_only_a_document: This supersession is machine-enforced, because a later agent reading a stale green receipt is exactly the failure mode being guarded against.
enforcement.mechanism: odyssey/launch/SUBSTRATE_CAPABILITY.json is a second gate, independent of ODYSSEY_LAUNCH_AUTHORIZED, keyed by artifact content hash. odyssey/training/run.py calls assert_trainable() for every stage past T0.
enforcement.verified_adversarially: with the fence flipped to true, `python3.12 odyssey/training/run.py T1` exits 5 SUBSTRATE_REFUSED. The fence was restored to false immediately afterwards.
enforcement.default_for_unknown_artifacts: UNVERIFIED, treated as REFUSED. Silence is not a pass.

what_survives_and_is_still_worth_having: The serve wire, the runtime, the codec, the numpy oracle, the attribution instrument, HIDE, Fabric, Bridge, the evaluation harness and the contamination barrier are all correct and all still useful. The defect is in one artifact. The machinery that found it is the machinery working as designed.
